nodes.label: Database Schema Documentation
nodes.rationale: Authoritative schema reference for the Trstprep V2.0 platform covering 78 collections/tables organized into 8 functional domains.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL
nodes.rationale: Primary relational database engine used for structured schema, joins, JSONB columns, and ACID transactions.

nodes.label: Supabase
nodes.rationale: Managed PostgreSQL hosting platform providing auth, RLS, and realtime features; chosen to reduce backend ops overhead.

nodes.label: MongoDB-like Helper Layer over PostgreSQL
nodes.rationale: Architecture exposes a MongoDB-style API (id/_id fields, JSON/JSONB columns) atop PostgreSQL to ease migration from NoSQL while retaining relational integrity.

nodes.label: Soft Delete via isActive Flag
nodes.rationale: Common boolean isActive field preserves audit history and allows restore; tradeoff is that queries must filter isActive=true.

nodes.label: Common Audit Timestamps (createdAt/updatedAt)
nodes.rationale: All tables carry createdAt and updatedAt to enable temporal queries and debugging.

nodes.label: Dual camelCase/snake_case Naming Convention
nodes.rationale: Legacy camelCase columns (isPro, isLive, attempted_tests JSONB) coexist with snake_case additions; indicates a multi-generation schema.

nodes.label: users
nodes.rationale: Core user identity table with auth, profile, pro subscription state, and embedded attempted_tests JSONB.

nodes.label: activityLogs
nodes.rationale: Audit trail of user actions with IP address for security monitoring.

nodes.label: testSeries
nodes.rationale: Bundles of related tests with pro/free split and merchandising metadata (thumbnail, rating, pinned order).

nodes.label: tests
nodes.rationale: Individual test instances belonging to a testSeries; supports multilingual delivery via languages array.

nodes.label: questions
nodes.rationale: Question bank with options array, negative marking, and difficulty classification; option images supported via questionImage.

nodes.label: attempts
nodes.rationale: Top-level test attempt with status lifecycle (in_progress/completed) and aggregate accuracy/score.

nodes.label: sectionAttempts
nodes.rationale: Granular per-section breakdown of an attempt to support multi-section exams (e.g. quant/English/reasoning).

nodes.label: results
nodes.rationale: Final result row with rank/percentile for leaderboard integration.

nodes.label: leaderboards
nodes.rationale: Materialized leaderboard with rankings array and publish flag.

nodes.label: leaderboard_entries
nodes.rationale: Normalised per-user leaderboard row scoped by leaderboard_type and scope_key, allowing multiple leaderboard views.

nodes.label: question_attempts
nodes.rationale: Per-question attempt telemetry including mark-for-review, time_spent_seconds, and visit counts to drive revision analytics.

nodes.label: testCategories
nodes.rationale: Self-referencing category tree (parentId) for hierarchical test browsing.

nodes.label: liveTests
nodes.rationale: Time-bound scheduled tests with registeredUsers roster for exam-day delivery.

nodes.label: studyMaterials
nodes.rationale: Top-level study course container with pro gating and aggregate counts (chaptersCount, videosCount).

nodes.label: chapters
nodes.rationale: Ordered grouping within a study material holding videoCount and pdfCount rollups.

nodes.label: subjectVideos
nodes.rationale: Video lessons linked to a study material and chapter, with isFree for paywall decisions.

nodes.label: subjectPdfs
nodes.rationale: PDF study resources mirroring subjectVideos gating model.

nodes.label: videos
nodes.rationale: Generic/standalone video collection separate from subjectVideos.

nodes.label: subjects
nodes.rationale: Top-level subject taxonomy used for browsing and content organization.

nodes.label: subject_parts
nodes.rationale: Sub-divisions of a subject linked to stages for curriculum mapping.

nodes.label: units
nodes.rationale: Units within a subject_part, enabling the subject -> part -> unit -> topic -> subtopic curriculum hierarchy.

nodes.label: topics
nodes.rationale: Topics belong to a subject and are the leaf grouping for question analytics.

nodes.label: subtopics
nodes.rationale: Finest granularity in curriculum hierarchy, child of a topic and stage-linked.

nodes.label: question_patterns
nodes.rationale: Classifies question types/patterns and links them to concepts and stages for adaptive testing.

nodes.label: topicTests
nodes.rationale: Binds a topic to a study material and aggregates questionsCount for topic-level practice.

nodes.label: quizzes
nodes.rationale: Lightweight quiz containers with explicit question_ids array, difficulty, and passing_score.

nodes.label: daily_quizzes
nodes.rationale: Date-keyed daily quiz for engagement/retention loops.

nodes.label: daily_quiz_questions
nodes.rationale: Join table ordering questions within a daily_quiz instance.

nodes.label: daily_quiz_attempts
nodes.rationale: User submissions for a daily quiz with score/accuracy; answers persisted as JSONB for replay analysis.

nodes.label: revision_queue
nodes.rationale: Spaced-repetition scheduler storing due_at and status per (user, question, source_attempt).

nodes.label: wrong_questions
nodes.rationale: Tracks per-user wrong-answer history to feed the revision queue and analytics dashboards.

nodes.label: user_topic_stats
nodes.rationale: Rollup of per-user per-topic accuracy to power dashboards and recommendations.

nodes.label: topic_analytics
nodes.rationale: Time-bucketed aggregate analytics per topic for trend reporting.

nodes.label: user_recommendations
nodes.rationale: Stores personalised recommendation payloads with a score for ranking.

nodes.label: study_streaks
nodes.rationale: Gamification streak counter (current/best/total active days) to drive daily engagement.

nodes.label: examCategories
nodes.rationale: High-level exam taxonomy (SSC, Banking, etc.) surfaced in the app navigation.

nodes.label: examSubCategories
nodes.rationale: Second-level exam grouping parented to examCategories.

nodes.label: stages
nodes.rationale: Exam stage definitions (Prelims/Mains/Interview) with order; referenced by curriculum entities.

nodes.label: examInfo
nodes.rationale: Canonical exam metadata (eligibility, syllabus, pattern) used by the exam-detail pages.

nodes.label: examYearlyData
nodes.rationale: Per-year vacancies and exam/result dates for time-sensitive exam information.

nodes.label: examUpdates
nodes.rationale: Editorial updates/news tied to a specific exam to keep exam pages current.

nodes.label: bookmarks
nodes.rationale: Polymorphic user bookmarks across test/question/video item types using itemType discriminator.

nodes.label: notifications
nodes.rationale: Per-user in-app notifications with read flag and type taxonomy.

nodes.label: doubts
nodes.rationale: User-asked questions/doubts with status lifecycle (open/answered/closed) and answersCount.

nodes.label: doubt_replies
nodes.rationale: Replies on a doubt with is_accepted flag for authoritative answers and upvotes.

nodes.label: questionDiscussions
nodes.rationale: Threaded discussions attached to a specific question for community explanations.

nodes.label: discussion_replies
nodes.rationale: Replies on questionDiscussions with upvotes for community-driven ranking.

nodes.label: discussion_votes
nodes.rationale: Per-user vote record (upvote/downvote) on either a discussion or a reply.

nodes.label: studyGroups
nodes.rationale: Public/private study groups with memberCount rollup and creator reference.

nodes.label: study_group_members
nodes.rationale: Join table for studyGroups with role (admin/member) and joined_at timestamp.

nodes.label: achievement_definitions
nodes.rationale: Catalog of unlockable achievements with JSONB criteria rule and reward points.

nodes.label: achievements
nodes.rationale: Alternative/older achievements table; appears redundant with achievement_definitions and may need consolidation.

nodes.label: userAchievements
nodes.rationale: Per-user earned achievements with timestamp; used for profile badges.

nodes.label: enrollments
nodes.rationale: User-to-testSeries enrollment record with payment reference for paid access.

nodes.label: subscriptionPlans
nodes.rationale: Catalog of subscription tiers with duration in days and feature list.

nodes.label: coupons
nodes.rationale: Discount codes with percentage/fixed type, minimum amount threshold, and usage cap.

nodes.label: promotions
nodes.rationale: Time-bounded promotional banners for marketing campaigns.

nodes.label: referrals
nodes.rationale: Referral program tracking with referrer/referred and reward-claim flag.

nodes.label: blogs
nodes.rationale: Editorial blog content with author, excerpt, tags and publishedAt for SEO.

nodes.label: assets
nodes.rationale: Generic uploaded asset registry (images, files) with uploader reference.

nodes.label: tagConfigs
nodes.rationale: Tag configuration with color and icon for UI rendering.

nodes.label: ui_tag_configs
nodes.rationale: UI-facing tag config with route/filterKey/filterValue to drive navigation and discovery.

nodes.label: banners
nodes.rationale: Promotional/homepage banner with link and placement position.

nodes.label: faqs
nodes.rationale: FAQ content with category and ordering for support pages.

nodes.label: testimonials
nodes.rationale: User testimonials with rating for marketing/social proof.

nodes.label: navigationMenu
nodes.rationale: CMS-driven navigation menu with self-referencing parentId for tree rendering.

nodes.label: appSettings
nodes.rationale: Key/value runtime configuration store with category grouping and JSON value type.

nodes.label: Curriculum Hierarchy (Subject > Part > Unit > Topic > Subtopic)
nodes.rationale: Five-level taxonomy enables granular learning paths and analytics, with stage_ids arrays allowing multi-stage mapping per node.

nodes.label: Pro Tier Gating (isPro flag)
nodes.rationale: Per-entity isPro/isFree flags enable freemium content strategy; user.pro_pass_expiry tracks subscription validity.

nodes.label: Section-based Exam Structure
nodes.rationale: attempts + sectionAttempts split enables multi-section timed exams with per-section timing and accuracy reporting.

nodes.label: Spaced Repetition via revision_queue
nodes.rationale: Per-user due_at schedule allows a Leitner/SRS-style re-show of questions; feeds off wrong_questions and question_attempts telemetry.

nodes.label: Engagement Gamification (streaks, achievements, daily quizzes)
nodes.rationale: study_streaks, userAchievements, daily_quizzes and discussion voting combine to incentivise daily return visits.
